project: CliffForge proof of concept (prototype; NOT a validated drug-discovery system)
compute: CPU only (low priority); no GPU used

dataset.name: COVID Moonshot noncovalent SARS-CoV-2 Mpro IC50 (pIC50 = 6 - log10 IC50[uM])
dataset.curated: data/moonshot/all.csv (src/cliffforge/data_prep.py, SEED=17, within-series split, replicates averaged, 2D / stereochemistry removed)
dataset.validation_set: none separate; ChemProp used an internal random val split of train; relative model used fixed 70 epochs with no early stopping / tuning on test

chemprop_abs.provenance: existing (internship); absolute pIC50; trained on data/moonshot/train.csv

rel_siamese.provenance: NEW in this PoC (src/cliffforge/relmodel.py; recipe of moonshot_ddg.py (internship research repository)), seeds 0,1,2, 70 epochs, train partition pairs only (4578 pairs)
rel_siamese.prediction: antisymmetrised pairwise delta, mean over checkpoints

generation.method: example-based matched-molecular-pair transformation transfer (RDKit); NOT a neural generator
generation.seed_selection_rule: held-out test compounds with pIC50>=7.0; max #filter-passing candidates (outcome-blind); table: results/metrics/seed_selection_table.csv

docking.reason: no docking software (vina/smina/gnina/obabel/meeko) installed and no Mpro structure in repo; not installed/downloaded because of the deadline and shared-host constraints

affinity_prediction_notes: model-predicted delta pIC50 vs seed on Moonshot Mpro (2D, no pocket); not measured, not docking

prior_internship_results_reported_not_ne.architectures: internship repository: results/arch_generalize.json, schnet_generalize.json (abs->rel all 5 improve)
prior_internship_results_reported_not_ne.cold_start: internship repository: results/series_holdout.json: advantage vanishes when whole series held out

warnings_and_untested: Only 5 strict held-out cliff pairs at the primary threshold: no model comparison is meaningful there.
Relative-model advantage on close analogues is exploratory (test-train) or non-significant (strict n=44, McNemar p=0.18).
On strict held-out large-gap cliffs (sim>=0.7/0.6) the absolute ChemProp is at least as good as the relative model.
Predicted gains for the demo seed (potent lead) are within assay noise; no candidate is predicted to be a clear improvement.
Pocket-aware scoring/docking not run; stereochemistry not modelled; generation limited to train-seen transformations.
No generated molecule has been synthesized or assayed.
Pair-level CIs treat pairs as independent although they share molecules.
Activity-cliff detection: verdict B (no demonstrated improvement over ChemProp); do not claim better cliff detection.
Strict-held-out primary cliff set has 5 positives; lead-optimization set (14 positives) is exploratory, not both-unseen.
Post-hoc setting-specific threshold check was added after seeing test results (disclosed; verdict unchanged).

activity_cliff_detection.question: does the relative-affinity model detect activity cliffs better than the existing ChemProp Mpro model?
activity_cliff_detection.verdict_statement: No demonstrated improvement over the baseline.

validation.scheme: 5-fold CV inside the train partition (random_state=0); fold models retrained with the same recipes; pairs = train-train Tanimoto>=0.80

rel_siamese.trained_on: pIC50 differences of same-series train pairs, data/moonshot/all.csv split==train

activity_cliff_detection.inference_protocol: held-out activities masked (NaN) at inference; thresholds from out-of-fold train-partition CV only; true cliff labels computed after predictions (posthoc_* columns)
activity_cliff_detection.reading: No demonstrated improvement. Strict A has 5 positives (descriptive). In B (reference activity available) ChemProp and 5-NN are at least as good as the relative model. Only threshold-free detection on strict held-out pairs at Tanimoto>=0.7/0.6 favours the relative model (CIs exclude 0).

provenance: Frozen reference-run summary produced in the internship research workspace and re-verified in this repository: the packaged modules reproduce the demo, ranking, recall and cliff-detection metrics (see results/README.md). Paths were mapped to this repository's layout.
limitation_notes: Hydrogen<->substituent edits were not matched in the reported generation runs (opt-in switch CLIFFFORGE_MATCH_H_SITES=1); reported edits are substituent-for-substituent swaps.
